scope: 24-branch development positive control; no training, calibration or complete ANS efficacy claim

reference.surface: unique union exterior mesh with existing observable filter

pre_outcome_structural_gates.paired_semantic_difference: only actual asset marker colors and their class interpretation
pre_outcome_structural_gates.background_fraction_denominator: fixed observable class1 reference weighted area
pre_outcome_structural_gates.candidate_front_direction: nearest cardinal direction from measured group toward common history first frame camera, not first frame observing each asset
pre_outcome_structural_gates.candidate_target_projection: nearest feasible state in the common known-safe orientation graph
pre_outcome_structural_gates.old_surface_rotation_selection: endpoint measured-point frustum support descending, cost ascending, pose ascending
pre_outcome_structural_gates.candidate_generation_input: only shared measured geometry and sensor map; no GT centers or regions
pre_outcome_structural_gates.west_east_deep_cost_rule: prefer equal; otherwise retain exact difference and report unequal-cost condition; no outcome-directed reselection
pre_outcome_structural_gates.actual_visit_cost_implementation: equivalent directed shortest distances over all-heading region states; min both west-east and east-west visit orders; restore original heading
pre_outcome_structural_gates.double_region_cost_formula: min over both region orders and all state pairs of d(start,z1)+d(z1,z2)+d(z2,start)
pre_outcome_structural_gates.failure_action: fail whole version before future branches; retain all worlds; no extra scans, threshold changes or world deletion

prediction_release.S_kind: explicit fixed asset-structure prior conditional response; not learned or calibrated
prediction_release.G_kind: strong shared sensor geometry with category-marginal response
prediction_release.O_kind: same accepted objectness and support as S with category-marginal response
prediction_release.N_kind: shared route coverage and measured old-surface quality control
prediction_release.X_kind: frozen S with only test class2/class3 interpretation exchanged
prediction_release.M_kind: actual missing interpretation path with exact G fallback
prediction_release.prior_dimensions_source: only shared measured geometry; never actual world dimensions
prediction_release.route_acquisition_factor: 25 fixed hypothetical back-plane points; each point max across route minus same point max across prefix clipped nonnegative; then mean points
prediction_release.prefix_acquisition_poses: all actual initial-plus-150-action frame camera poses in original order
prediction_release.G_group_support: all accepted common sensor geometry groups
prediction_release.S_X_group_support: marker groups with conditional prior; unmarked groups generic fallback
prediction_release.S_O_support_fairness: structural gate requires both accepted geometry groups actually marked; any unmarked group invalidates this positive control
prediction_release.dimension_missing_rule: retain measured zero or degeneracy; no actual world dimension fallback
prediction_release.tie_rule: score descending, planned paid cost ascending, candidate_id ascending

execution.zero_paid_action_rate: undefined and retained, never imputed zero

post_branch_exclusivity_gate.fraction_denominator: that slot fixed prefix-unseen observable reference weighted area
post_branch_exclusivity_gate.failure_action: mechanism fails; retain every original branch and metric; no posthoc candidate deletion

metrics.visibility: actual valid depth pixel and physical camera plus GT mesh first hit
metrics.branch_joint_auc_rule: linear interpolation of prefix, arrival, final and failure checkpoints; hold final after shorter route

progression_necessary_conditions.meaning: worth separately preregistering new T/C; not old independent gates passed or complete scheme superiority
progression_necessary_conditions.failure_action: stop this version, retain all data, no outcome-directed retuning or additional samples
